assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons are provisional (maintainer-defined from public text descriptions). All area calculations are approximate and must be recalculated when official polygons become available.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics are provisional. Land use, buildings, roads, green space, public space, and phasing layers must be regenerated when official boundary replaces provisional.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, building height, building density, setbacks, road redlines) are not available. All development intensity references are conceptual only.
assumptions.impact: Building height, FAR, density, and setback controls cannot be specified. Spatial design expresses conceptual relationships only.

assumptions.statement: No existing building survey (age, structure, use, ownership) is available. Building footprints in geometry are conceptual massing proxies.
assumptions.impact: Retain/renovate/demolish classification is methodological only. No building-specific decisions can be made.

assumptions.statement: Heritage protection boundaries for cultural relics within the design area are not available in the repository.
assumptions.impact: All heritage-adjacent design proposals are directional only.

assumptions.statement: No municipal infrastructure data (pipelines, energy, drainage, flood control, fire protection) is available. Infrastructure references are conceptual service logic.
assumptions.impact: No capacity calculations or engineering line positions can be provided.

assumptions.statement: Detailed Metro station designs, passenger flow data, and entrance/exit locations are not available.
assumptions.impact: Transit-station integration proposals are conceptual orientations only.

assumptions.statement: No investment budgets, funding sources, or implementation entities are specified. All project lists, phasing, and operational proposals are conceptual suggestions.
assumptions.impact: Nothing in this proposal constitutes a funding commitment or project approval.

assumptions.statement: Land use partitions are conceptual functional zones derived from the provisional site boundary. They express design intent rather than statutory parcel boundaries.
assumptions.impact: Land use areas, proportions, and boundaries are conceptual and not statutory.

assumptions.statement: Figures (PNG), A3/A0 PDFs, and visual/index.html are generated from provisional geometry and metrics. They are human-readable interpretation layers, not authoritative data.
assumptions.impact: Visual assets should be regenerated when official geometry replaces provisional.

assumptions.statement: Multiple data gaps from missing_data_checklist.csv exist. Per organizer policy, these gaps do not block content scoring but limit the precision of the proposal.
assumptions.impact: Proposal expresses design direction and methodology rather than final engineering or statutory conclusions.
